Name: Alternate Portraits and Sprites for Abandoned Bride
Author: AirynS
Description:
Alternate portraits and sprites for the main NPC from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6471?]Abandoned Bride[/url] by Brimini. This mod will not work without Abandoned Bride because it’s a portrait replacer, so please download & endorse Brimini’s work.

To install, just unzip and drop the “[CP] Alternate Portraits for Abandoned Bride” folder into your Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]:
[list]
[*][b]VeilOption[/b]: Configures whether the Bride has a veil in her portraits to match her sprites or no veil to match her original portraits
[*][b]NoEyeStrain[/b]: Configures whether her beach portraits have a potentially straining blur effect.
[/list]
If you like my work, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/airyn]here![/url]
